records.name: Stochastic Systems
records.scope_notes: Applied probability, queues, stochastic models, computational methods and applications in service operations, logistics, computer systems and related OR domains. Regular manuscripts require a substantive contribution; short correspondences are also accepted. Computational health-system work fits without clinical practice.

route.conditions: Current journal instructions explicitly exclude APCs and submission fees. Regular manuscripts are limited to 35 pages including references; short correspondences to eight pages. No membership or institutional agreement is required by the stated policy.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none stated in current submission and publication instructions

fee_evidence.note: The Open Access section states that all content is open access under CC BY, authors retain copyright, and neither article processing charges nor submission fees apply.

difficulty.basis: Discovery did not establish a difficulty band or acceptance probability.

records.name: Mathematics of Operations Research
records.scope_notes: Foundational mathematical work in optimization, stochastic processes, queues, simulation methodology, networks, control, games and decision theory. The instructions require originality, quality and significance; correctness alone is insufficient.

route.conditions: Standard subscription publication exists alongside optional paid INFORMS Open Option. The reviewed pages do not explicitly exclude submission, page or membership charges. Normally at most 40 manuscript pages excluding references; up to 45 may be considered with justification. Print color is optional and charged.
route.other_mandatory_costs: unknown; explicit confirmation of submission, standard publication, page and membership costs still required

fee_evidence.note: The After Acceptance section identifies paid open access as an alternative to subscription publication and print color as an author-elected expense, but does not expressly say standard submission/publication is free.
Publisher policy makes Open Option elective, with no effect on consideration or publication eligibility. This establishes optional OA, not absence of all other author charges.

difficulty.basis: Discovery records contribution criteria but leaves difficulty assessment to the ranking audit.

records.name: Operations Research
records.scope_notes: Analytical methods that advance decision-making, including theoretical and computational operations research. Offers focused technical and regular manuscripts; context-and-challenge papers are usually invited. Computational experiments require attention to journal data/software disclosure rules.

route.conditions: Optional paid OA is documented, but no explicit no-fee standard-route statement was found. Regular manuscripts are limited to 30 pages excluding references; longer manuscripts are generally at most 40. Print color incurs a cost only if elected. Journal fees must not be inferred from other INFORMS journals.
route.other_mandatory_costs: unknown; submission, standard publication, page and membership costs need explicit confirmation

fee_evidence.note: The journal offers subscription publication and optional paid Open Option, and makes print color an optional additional expense. It does not explicitly rule out standard submission/publication charges.
Open Option is elective and does not affect editorial consideration or publication eligibility; that does not independently prove every other cost is absent.

difficulty.basis: No acceptance odds or difficulty band established in discovery.

records.name: INFORMS Journal on Computing
records.scope_notes: Theories, computational experiments, systems, methods and applications at the intersection of computing and OR; surveys, tutorials and useful software tools are welcome. Computational-experiment contributions require software and data sufficient to reproduce results.

route.conditions: Paid OA is optional; ordinary subscription publication remains available. No explicit no-submission-fee or no-page/member-charge statement was located. Main manuscripts are limited to 25 pages, with up to ten appendix pages; exceptions need editorial discussion. Print color is optional and charged.
route.other_mandatory_costs: unknown; submission, standard publication, page and membership costs need explicit confirmation

fee_evidence.note: Journal instructions distinguish subscription from elective paid Open Option and state that authors may elect paid print color. They do not explicitly confirm zero costs for all aspects of the standard route.
Publisher policy establishes that the Open Option fee is optional and unrelated to editorial decisions; it is not a complete standard-route fee statement.

difficulty.basis: No discovery-stage difficulty assessment; citation impact is not used as acceptance evidence.

records.name: Queueing Systems
records.scope_notes: Queueing theory, resource sharing and queueing networks, stochastic models, rare-event simulation, variance reduction and data-driven queue control. Welcomes regular research, short communications, surveys and research-direction papers; best suited to substantial probabilistic or methodological contributions.

route.conditions: The journal-specific publishing page explicitly provides a subscription route with no APC. Online color is free; print color is charged and can be avoided. The reviewed instructions do not explicitly exclude submission fees, page charges or compulsory society membership.
route.other_mandatory_costs: unknown; no submission/page/member charge confirmation located; optional print color and offprints are chargeable

fee_evidence.note: Authors may choose the subscription publishing model after acceptance without APC charges; paid OA is a separate option.
Online color is free, print color requires a contribution, and offprints may be ordered. No explicit no-submission-fee or no-page-charge assurance was found.

difficulty.basis: No discovery-stage difficulty assessment or acceptance statistics.

records.name: Annals of Operations Research
records.scope_notes: OR theory, practice and computation, including full research articles, short notes, surveys, computational studies and innovative applications. General submissions and refereed special volumes are supported. Computational and existing-data work can fit; a special volume is not an acceptance guarantee.

route.conditions: Journal-specific policy confirms no APC for the subscription route. Optional OA and print color can cost money; online color is free. Submission/page/member charges were not explicitly excluded in the reviewed sources, so the whole route remains unverified.
route.other_mandatory_costs: unknown; explicit submission/page/member cost confirmation still required; optional print color and offprints are chargeable

fee_evidence.note: The journal offers subscription publication with no APC charges, distinct from paid open access.
The instructions state that online color is free but print color costs extra and offprints can be ordered. They do not expressly address every submission or page charge.

difficulty.basis: No discovery-stage difficulty assessment or acceptance probability.

records.name: OR Spectrum
records.scope_notes: Applied and theoretical quantitative approaches for strategic, tactical and operational decisions. Contributions to science and practice must be articulated; surveys and empirical studies supporting improvements in quantitative methods are in scope.

route.conditions: The journal-specific publishing policy confirms a subscription option without APC charges. Online color is free; print color and optional OA can cost money. No explicit statement eliminating submission, page or membership charges was found.
route.other_mandatory_costs: unknown; explicit submission/page/member cost confirmation still required; optional print color and offprints are chargeable

fee_evidence.note: The journal explicitly allows authors to select subscription publication without APC charges after acceptance.
Online color is free and print color incurs an extra cost; offprints may be ordered. No comprehensive no-submission-fee/no-page-charge statement was located.

difficulty.basis: Discovery leaves difficulty and selectivity assessment to the ranking audit.

records.name: SIMULATION
records.publisher: Sage; The Society for Modeling and Simulation International
records.scope_notes: General modeling and simulation theory, methodology, technology and applications, with relevance beyond a single implementation. Original research, reviews, case reports and letters are listed in current author instructions. Computational model development, evaluation and synthesis fit OSRI's nonlaboratory scope.

route.conditions: Current journal instructions explicitly state no fees to submit or publish. Use ordinary subscription publication and avoid requested print color; online color is free. Optional paid Sage Choice OA and affiliation-based agreements are separate routes. No compulsory membership is stated.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none stated for ordinary subscription publication; optional print color is charged

fee_evidence.note: Journal-specific Publishing fees section explicitly excludes submission/publication fees, makes OA elective, and provides free online color while charging for requested print color.

difficulty.basis: No discovery-stage difficulty assessment; no metrics transcribed without their reporting period.

records.name: Simulation & Gaming
records.scope_notes: Simulation and gaming methods for education, training, decision-making and research; relevant to informatics, serious games and research methods. Research articles, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, theoretical articles and research-grounded usable simulations are eligible. General queueing or optimization requires this simulation/gaming connection.

route.conditions: Explicitly no fees to submit or publish on the subscription route; paid OA is optional. Online color is free; avoid requested print color. Respect article-specific limits: research articles 7000 words, short reports 3000, theoretical and ready-to-use simulations 5000, excluding references.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none stated for standard subscription publication; optional print color is charged

fee_evidence.note: Current instructions explicitly exclude submission/publication fees and distinguish optional paid OA and print color from free online color.

difficulty.basis: Official overview displays metrics but the rendered page does not identify their period; discovery makes no selectivity inference.

records.name: The Journal of Defense Modeling and Simulation: Applications, Methodology, Technology
records.publisher: Sage; The Society for Modeling and Simulation International
records.scope_notes: Specialist outlet for modeling and simulation related to defense, emphasizing practical technical lessons, methodology and applications. Relevant only when a computational engineering study has an explicit defense-domain connection; not a general venue for health-system or ordinary OR work. Inclusion is a venue lead, not adoption of defense research as an OSRI priority.

route.conditions: Current journal instructions explicitly exclude submission/publication fees; paid OA is optional and online color is free. Avoid requested print color. Papers are ideally 10-20 pages although the stated submission policy imposes no fixed length restriction. No compulsory membership is stated.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none stated for standard subscription publication; optional print color is charged

fee_evidence.note: Current journal-specific instructions state no submit/publish fees, describe optional paid OA, and restrict color charges to requested print reproduction.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty inference from the undated metrics on the overview page.

notes: Ten credible journal leads were examined on official publisher or society pages. Four explicitly cover zero-cost submission and publication; six remain needs_verification because an APC-free or optional-OA policy alone does not prove all compulsory author costs are absent.

Scope favors computational, mathematical, existing-data and synthesis work. The defense-specific journal is a narrow specialist lead; its inclusion does not establish defense as an OSRI program priority.

Metrics are intentionally empty. The separate ranking role should verify reporting period and denominator before retaining official Sage overview numbers. Difficulty remains unknown and is not inferred from citation metrics or absence of data.

Excluded from this record set after initial exploration: Journal of Simulation (Taylor & Francis author instructions blocked with HTTP 403), Computers & Operations Research (ScienceDirect guide blocked with HTTP 403). Neither block proves that authors are charged. Additional Springer leads left for expansion include Computational Optimization and Applications and Discrete Event Dynamic Systems.

No membership or page-charge assumptions were transferred between INFORMS journals; their optional OA policy does not establish a complete cost-free standard route. No waivers or institutional agreements are counted as unconditional free access.
Agent discovery is a bounded policy check, not human scientific review, acceptance prediction, manuscript-specific matching or authorization to submit.
